description: nowrap keeps the text on one line, overflowing the box.

florui.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
florui.css: .p { width: 90px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 9.26% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 47.14% and the box is 66.0px off, so it fails.
